cancellation.intro: We understand that plans may change. Our cancellation policy is designed to be fair while covering the costs involved in preparing and delivering each experience.

rules.when: More than 7 days before the experience
rules.what: A full refund, excluding any non-refundable costs already incurred in preparing the experience.
50% of the total amount paid is refunded.

rescheduling: Where possible, we are happy to move your experience to another available date.
The amount already paid can be transferred to the new date. Any additional costs caused by the change, including supplier or venue fees, may apply.
cancellation.exceptional: In exceptional circumstances, we may review cancellation or rescheduling terms case by case.
